title: Detecting single cell interferon-beta production using a fluorescent reporter telomerase-immortalized human fibroblast cell line
protocol: Transfer glass coverslips soaked in 70% ethanol to a 12-well plate using sterile forceps.
Wash the coverslips with PBS before adding cell suspension.
Add 1.5 × 10^6 THF IFN-GFP cells in 10 mL to 10 cm dishes and 1 × 10^5 THF IFN GFP cells in 1 mL per well to coverslips in 12-well plates.
Incubate the cells for 16–24 h.
Dissociate and re-suspend cells in the count well with trypsin-EDTA.
Count cells using a glass hemocytometer.
Dilute SeV to 2 plaque-forming units (pfu)/cell in minimal volume of serum-free medium.
Dilute HCMV to 0.3 pfu/cell in minimal volume of serum-free medium.
Add 0.5 mL of diluted virus per well to a 12-well plate.
Expose virus to pre-optimized UV-radiation in a stratolinker UV cross-linker.
Remove medium from cells and add live or UV-inactivated virus.
Incubate cells at 37°C for 1 hour, rocking plates periodically.
Replace medium containing inactivated virus with maintenance medium (2% FBS DMEM).
Incubate for 16–24 hours while GFP is expressed and accumulates in cells.
Wash THF cells in 10 cm dishes with PBS.
Incubate cells with trypsin-EDTA at 37°C until thoroughly dissociated.
Resuspend dissociated cells in sorting buffer and pellet at 500 × g and 4°C for 5 min.
Resuspend cell pellet in Cytofix/Cytoperm solution, transfer to a round bottom 96-well plate and incubate at 4°C for 20 min to fix.
Pellet cells at 500 × g and 4°C for 5 min and wash twice with Perm/Wash buffer.
Stain cells for expression of ISG15 using mouse anti-ISG15 diluted in Perm/Wash buffer.
Incubate stained cells at 4°C for 30 min.
Pellet cells at 500 × g and 4°C for 5 min and wash twice with Perm/Wash buffer.
Resuspend cells in APC-conjugated anti-mouse diluted in Perm/Wash buffer and incubate at 4°C for 30 min in the dark.
Pellet cells at 500 × g and 4°C for 5 minutes.
Wash cells twice with 100 μL of Perm/Wash buffer.
Resuspend cells in 1 mL of sorting buffer.
Optimize antibody dilutions to minimize background staining.
Measure single cell fluorescence using Beckman Coulter MoFlo XDP (or similar flow analyzer).
Set FSC/SSC gate and the negative gate for ISG15 expression and GFP using mock treated cells.
Quantify expression of ISG15 and GFP in fixed and permeabilized cells with anti-ISG15 and APC-conjugated anti-mouse antibodies.
Be careful to avoid exposing fixed cells to light due to sensitivity of GFP and APC-conjugated antibody to light.
Detect IFN production by fluorescence microscopy.
Fix and permeabilize cells with formalin.
Wash cells with PBS.
Add 1 mL of 10% formalin per well and incubate for 10 min at 23°C away from direct light.
Remove formalin and wash off any excess formalin with PBS.
Add 1 mL of 0.2% Tx-100 in PBS per well and incubate for 10 min at 23°C away from direct light.
Wash cells with PBS.
Add 1 mL of IF blocking buffer per well and incubate for 1 h at 4°C in the dark.
Stain cells with SeV- and ISG15-specific antibodies.
Dilute mouse anti-SeV 1:2000 and mouse anti-ISG15 1:50 separately in IF blocking buffer.
Remove IF blocking buffer and use forceps to center coverslips within the well.
Add just enough diluted antibody to cover the coverslip (∼30 μL) and incubate for 1 h in the dark.
Dilute Alexa Fluor 594-conjugated anti-mouse IgG (Invitrogen) 1:500 and Alexa Fluor 488-conjugated anti-GFP (invitrogen) 1:1000 together in IF blocking buffer.
Wash three times with PBS and once with IF blocking buffer.
Center the coverslip, add just enough secondary antibody to cover the coverslip (∼30 μL) and incubate for 1 h in the dark.
Dilute Hoechst 33342 1:5000 in PBS.
Wash with PBS.
Add 0.5 mL of Hoechst per well and incubate for 10 min in the dark.
Mount coverslips on slides.
Discard Hoechst.
Wash samples three times with PBS.
Wash samples once with water to avoid salt crystallization.
Properly dispose of Hoechst and the first PBS wash.
Add approximately 3 μL of mounting medium to slides where coverslips will be placed.
Carefully lift the coverslips using forceps.
Blot excess liquid from the edges of the coverslips.
Lower the coverslips onto the mounting medium carefully to avoid air bubbles.
Pause point: Store covered slides at 4°C for several days with proper anti-fade mounting media.
Visualize cells with a fluorescence microscope.
If GFP fluorescence is too low or background fluorescence is too high, refer to troubleshooting guidelines.
